## Description

Batch transcription of the completed recording (authoritative source), diarisation into provisional speakers, per-segment language and original-language text with English translation, timestamps and confidence bands. TRANSCRIPT, TRANSCRIPT_SEGMENT (encrypted content), SPEAKER_LABEL (provisional). Provisional live captions never populate the record.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A 10-minute synthetic consultation is transcribed and diarised with segments, timestamps, language tags and translations.
- [ ] **AC2.** Segment content is stored encrypted; no transcript text appears in logs/telemetry.
- [ ] **AC3.** Transcription latency contributes ≤ 40 s p50 for a 10-minute visit, leaving budget for drafting (overall ≤ 60 s p50 measured in MDV-P3-025).
- [ ] **AC4.** Low-confidence segments are marked and surfaced in review.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
